text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert: multiple CUDA OOMs on node gpu-prod-12 in the last 10m. 12 OOMs, increasing resident pages for kv-cache, paged-attn allocator showing fragmentation growth. Triage channel created. link: https://redwood/troubleshoot/playbooks/oom-paged-attn

Maya: I'm oncall. seeing repeated stack traces, attaching the recent snippet. Looks like slow memory creep over 36-48h, not a sudden spike.

Maya: ```
2026-03-15T03:12:08Z runtime ERROR CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2GiB
  at redwood/runtime/allocator.c:482
  at redwood/runtime/paged_attn.c:1024
  kv_cache resident_pages=1.9GB -> 2.3GB over 48h
  pager stats: free_fragments=24, largest_free=64MB, alloc_failures=7
```

Jun: Noted. Quick mitigations to try: increase eviction aggressiveness and disable warmup. I'll push config to one node first. Proposed changes: `kv_cache.max_resident_ratio=0.55`, `kv_warmup.enabled=false`, `paged_attn.evict_interval=30s`.

Jun: Run this on node gpu-prod-12 for canary: ```
kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/runtime-gpu-prod-12 -- bash -c '
  sctl config set kv_cache.max_resident_ratio 0.55 && \\n  sctl config set kv_warmup.enabled false && \\n  sctl config set paged_attn.evict_interval 30s && \\n  sctl restart runtime-service'
```

Alex: Which pods are the heavy ones? `kubectl top pods --sort-by=memory` shows `runtime-serve-3` and `runtime-serve-7` pegged on gpu-prod-12. Recommend restarting the lower priority pod first.

Ria: I restarted `runtime-serve-7` on gpu-prod-12. It flapped once and came back. Memory dropped ~200MB on that pod but node aggregate still high.

Samir: I'm going to flip routing to fallback-model for the critical route to reduce token lengths and mem pressure. Patch via API: ```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/adjust -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"/generate","fallback_model":"redwood-small","percentage":100}'
```

Maya: Customer impact: the metrics show ~18 failed generation requests in the last 30m, and latency spikes up to 8s. CS ticket created: CS-4521, customers flagged: acme-inc, finlytics. Notifying accounts. :exclamation:

Jun: We're seeing allocator fragmentation metrics consistent with slow page leakage in the KV slab: slab_retained++ while evictions are not reclaiming large contiguous segments. I want a heap dump + nvml memory report captured from the node before more restarts. Ops-bot please run the collector. @ops-bot can you grab `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo` and `pmap` on the top PID?

ops-bot: Running collectors now. Attached: /artifacts/4356789012/node-gpu-prod-12/nvml.txt and pmap_top_pid.txt. Picking top PID 12345 (runtime).

Samir: If config pushes don't stabilize in 10m, escalate to rolling node cordon + recreate to force compacting: `kubectl drain gpu-prod-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then rebuild. We'll schedule a short maintenance window if needed.

Alex: Agree. Also open to increasing node pool by +1 temporarily to reduce scheduling pressure if that helps latency for customers.

Maya: Current status: canary config applied to runtime-serve-7, routing switched to fallback-model, restarted one pod. Errors per minute dropped from 0.6 -> 0.2 but memory still creeping. Need longer observation.

Jun: Next steps checklist: 1) collect full allocator hist and slab bitmap (done by ops-bot) 2) run `sctl slab defrag --node gpu-prod-12 --dry-run` to see reclaimable ranges 3) if dry-run positive, schedule live defrag (low-risk rolling) 4) create bug with traces and set P1 if reproducible.

Maya: Created bug INF-2026 with logs and collector links. Assigning to @Jun and @Samir for root cause and mitigation.

Ria: Noted we should communicate status to affected customers: DM sent to CS with suggested wording and ETA 60-90m for mitigation actions.

Jun: Marking this thread: ongoing mitigation. I'll update in 10m with results from defrag dry-run. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
